Resolves #19741

🌿 A seat can no longer start a second session that speaks in its name without its context.

Four entries join `Workflow` in `permissions.deny` of `.claude/settings.template.json`: `mcp__ccd_session__start_session`, `mcp__ccd_session__hand_off_to_session`, `mcp__scheduled-tasks__create_scheduled_task` and `mcp__scheduled-tasks__run_scheduled_task`. Each one starts another session that inherits the seat's GitHub, A2A and Memory Core identity, but none of its context. Nothing else in the file moves. Same-session wakeups and the `Agent` ask rule are unchanged, and the operator still starts sessions from the app UI. With the operator's go, the same four entries are already copied into all five Claude seats' generated `.claude/settings.json`, because the materializer only clones the template into an absent file (#19650).

Evidence: L2 (file-level: template and five generated settings files valid, with the exact array delta) → L3 required (AC-3: a fresh Claude Desktop session on a seat with the entries does not offer or run the spawning tools). Residual: AC-3, Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-brain#571

Micro-review eligible: config-denylist — four strings added to one JSON array, no code.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline jobs run in CI.
